name: Wyvern Girl
source:
She has large breasts, but she isn't overweight. She has a condition where breast milk leaks when her breasts are touched.

She unconsciously finds being dominated pleasurable, having a somewhat masochistic tendency.

[From the [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid/charactor07.html]Official website[/url]]
